cases.answer: The Nexon Fearless+PS petrol DCA features a 26.03 cm touchscreen and a 9-speaker JBL audio system with a subwoofer. In comparison, the Venue HX10 lists a 31.24 cm navigation screen and an 8-speaker Bose system; that is as per their website when we checked — please verify on their site.

For your exact automatics, Nexon Fearless+PS petrol has a 7-Speed DCA, while Brezza ZXi+ petrol has a 6-speed automatic available. On safety, Nexon also lists ADAS features, while Brezza lists 6 airbags, ESP, Hill Hold and ISOFIX; that is as per their website when we checked — please verify on their site.

Tata lists an advertised basic warranty of 3 years | 100 000 km, though the relationship between the duration and distance is not supplied. The New Brezza states a standard warranty of 3 years or 1 00 000 km whichever is earlier; that is as per their website when we checked — please verify on their site.
